authority.source: explicit user check that missing instruction files must not break or stop the managed pool
authority.scope: existence, readability, bootstrap fallback, exact-path repair and recovery of repository instruction controls
does_not_change: the Phase-1 zero-Work, zero-finite-quota and zero-cost gates
primary O authority or the protected O monitor

required_central_controls.consumers: clean and downstream roles plus optimizer

unexpected_404_or_missing: Never self-disable, pause, delete, replace or declare role/root completion.
Never execute substantive work from a stale prompt-only default when the current semantic authority file is absent.

Use only the embedded emergency lifecycle fallback: no optional semantic work, no wait/poll/backoff, no scheduler mutation, one compact diagnostic write/readback when safely authorized, normal return before 20 seconds, enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false and nonempty retry continuation.
Treat the missing path as an unresolved control-plane child problem, not as an irreducible handoff or solved condition.
Other roles whose required controls are readable continue independently; one role-control loss must not stop the full pool.
transient_unreadable_or_connector_error: Do not infer deletion from a transient read failure.
Do not write or recreate the control in the worker run.
Persist the exact read error if a safe role-local diagnostic surface exists and return recurring-open without same-run retry.
worker_missing_instruction_contract.RUN_LIFECYCLE_missing: Use the lifecycle fallback embedded in the physical automation prompt; do not attempt substantive work, do not cross 20 seconds and do not mutate scheduler state.
worker_missing_instruction_contract.semantic_control_missing: Fail closed for substantive semantics while keeping the recurring task physically enabled and schedulable.

order: Read this manifest and RUN_LIFECYCLE before live scheduler inventory.
Fetch each role's required paths by exact repository path and classify present, transient-unreadable or confirmed-404.
Re-enable stopped enabled_desired tasks independently of file repair, using the same task id only.

For a confirmed unexpected 404 with no newer explicit user-authorized deletion, retrieve the latest valid same-path version from Git history, validate schema/role/path and fixed constraints, restore to the identical path, and exact-readback it.
For transient errors, do not recreate; record and retry next optimizer invocation.
After any restore, refresh this manifest's current blob metadata and exact-readback the manifest.
Verify every physical prompt contains the embedded missing-instruction fallback and repair only drifted same tasks.
optimizer_repair_contract.if_no_safe_historical_restore: Keep the affected role enabled but diagnostic-only, continue all unaffected roles, preserve the missing path as an unresolved Phase-1 child and retry a safe reconstruction path on later runs.

prompt_embedded_emergency_fallback: If any required repository instruction file, including RUN_LIFECYCLE, is missing or unreadable: do not use stale substantive prompt defaults; do not disable or mutate the scheduler; perform no optional semantic work; record at most one compact role-safe diagnostic if possible; preserve enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false and a nonempty exact retry continuation; return normally before 20 seconds and emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION::.
exact_next_action: Optimizer must incorporate this manifest into the physical prompt drift guard at minute59, verify all 19 prompts contain the emergency fallback, and continue normal two-boundary lifecycle persistence verification.
